request: Random-access stream decryption must accept a complete authenticated ciphertext from any conforming io.ReaderAt, including one returning EOF alongside a full final read; incomplete ciphertext must remain an error.

defects.description: The constructor rejects EOF even when ReadAt supplied the complete final ciphertext chunk, contrary to the ReaderAt contract.
defects.why_missed: The shipped tests use readers returning nil on a full read; that misses legal full-read EOF behavior.
